title: Gothenburg Cathedral
geometryBasis: Named native way 24059735 fixes the principal walls, transepts, annex and faceted east apse. Three cleared exterior photos control the open west portico, upper clock stage, arched openings, oculi and east annex.
sectionBasis: The west approach defines model zero in the original Terrarium field. The parish’s 52.85-meter height governs the top of the tower. Remaining sections are estimates from the photographs.
limitations: December 2025 exterior. The surviving east form is guided by two cleared 2008 photographs. Interiors and surrounding grounds are outside the asset.
Secondary roof junctions, fine clock ornament, window tracery and individual stone courses are approximate.
The original terrain is retained. Foundation and individual threshold heights are approximate.
